'''Theta Squad''' was an Imperial [[squad]] composed of six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and stationed at the [[Whisper Base]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
